printed_common.stub: 410 wide x 75 thick, top 160 below deck top
printed_common.chamfers: 20x20 soffit chamfer (typ), 20x20 fillet at void-top corners (typ), 40x40 fillet under flanges (typ), 15x15 chamfer at flange tips (typ)
printed_common.kerb: 755 overall (390 above 365 underside on Types 1/2, 335 above 420 underside on Type 3); 300 top flat, 25 run on the inner face, printed 5/150/10 vertical detail

geometry_notes: Both web faces batter 1:17.6 outward going up: 21 mm over 365 mm (100 -> 79 printed) and 25 mm over 440 mm (810 -> 760 printed) both close within 0.3 mm.
Origin: x = 0 at the centre of the 810 mm gap between the web soffits (for the asymmetric external modules this is the double-T body centre, not the centroid); y = 0 at soffit.
Chamfer/fillet legs are taken horizontal and vertical (convention).
Kerb outer corners are chamfered 15 x 15 (the drawing shows small chamfers there; the 15 x 15 'typ' note is applied as a convention).

Kerb's 5 mm top detail and 10 mm drainage-level recess are ignored; the inner kerb face runs straight from the end of the 300 mm top flat to deck level 25 mm further in (convention; area effect < 200 mm2).

Type 2 printed top chain 325 + 107 = 432 to the left web outer face at 365 mm, whereas the soffit chain 450 and the 17.6:1 batter give 429.3 mm: 2.7 mm closure mismatch. The soffit chain (450) is used and the mismatch is recorded.
Excluded: 450 mm solid end blocks, 220x250x5 bearing recesses, 50 dia vent holes, drainage pipes, anchor bolts, holding-down bracket recesses, projecting reinforcement.

No section properties are published. Mass check (text layer of SHEET A general notes): Type 1 internal module approx 13.1 / 16.4 / 19.7 t for the 8 / 10 / 12 m sets (module lengths 7970/9970/11970 assumed from the 9970 printed for 10 m). The span-to-span increment 3.3 t per 2.0 m at 2550 kg/m3 implies a prismatic area of 0.647 m2 (+/-3% from 0.1 t rounding); the implemented T1-internal area is 0.6414 m2 (-0.9%). Type 1 external 16.9 t and Type 3 19.6 t (10 m) include end blocks; prismatic 9.97 m masses are 16.76 t and 19.28 t.
